title: cocculus ovatus
intro: Cocculus ovatus, commonly known as the "parasympathetic plant" or "parasympathetic berry," is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Cocculus ovatus include its use in traditional medicine to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help to calm the nervous system and promote a sense of well-being. The bioactive constituents of Cocculus ovatus include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
